remarks: Discover waterfront charm at 7 River Road, Unit 310 in Cos Cob. This inviting condo offers stunning water views from a sun-filled living area featuring expansive windows, a beautiful fireplace, and direct access to a private balcony. The first floor includes a convenient in-unit washer and dryer and a modern kitchen with new appliances. Upstairs, two bright bedrooms boast vaulted ceilings and skylights, with one offering access to a second balcony. Ample storage includes two assigned parking spaces and additional garage storage. Experience all that Cos Cob has to offer!
